correctness.rationale: A five-input median lies inside the interval of any three selected inputs. This gives a rigorous successive variation-of-constants bound for a leaf ordering of the unpinned induced forest. Conversely a cycle supports a perpetual high-opinion cohesive subset. The submitted script independently passed 524256 exhaustive labelled subsets for n=5..18, 982 symbolic constructions and 48 approximate trajectory consistency checks; these are supplements, not infinite proofs.
